note: Story arcs are the public storylines. Every story carries 1-3 arc ids; scripts chain stories by arc to build follows/related edges in the knowledge graph. 'threads' links an arc to hidden truths for internal analysis only and never appears in public outputs.

arcs.name: Coastal Bend life
arcs.description: Quiet-day local life: tourism, fishing, schools, port jobs, base community, summer heat and water conservation.

arcs.name: Hurricane Rafael
arcs.description: Outlook, formation, watches and warnings, evacuation, landfall, damage, bridges, power.

arcs.name: Water crisis
arcs.description: O.N. Stevens plant loses power, pumps fail, citywide boil-water notice, parts delay, notice lifted, hardening plan.

arcs.name: Public health
arcs.description: ER strain, stomach illness from water, respiratory and skin complaints near the spill, wastewater signals, lingering gaps.

arcs.name: Inner Harbor oil spill
arcs.description: Discharge from two moored tankers as the storm hit, oil in the bays, cleanup, fishery closures, claims.

arcs.name: How the valves opened
arcs.description: Investigation into unauthorized remote access to the tankers' cargo systems, vendor credential misuse, federal advisory, attribution.

arcs.name: Ship channel and exports
arcs.description: Channel closures, anchorage backlog, export halts, relief cargo, reopenings.

arcs.name: Bases and the deployment
arcs.description: NAS Corpus Christi, the Army depot and NAS Kingsville: evacuation, damage, relief flights, generator outage, the delayed Fort Hood outload.

arcs.name: Lights over the air station
arcs.description: Residents film drones over NAS Corpus Christi after the storm; statements; investigation; security review.

arcs.name: GPS interference
arcs.description: Pilots report GPS interference during relief flights; FAA notice; transmitter found near an Inner Harbor industrial area.

arcs.name: Blast at the jetties
arcs.description: Explosion beside a tug, channel closure, Navy clearance, second device, reopening, delayed outload.

arcs.name: A vessel in two places
arcs.description: Public AIS shows a fishing vessel's identity off Port Aransas while it reported 600 nm away; analysts note timing.

arcs.name: Relief and federal aid
arcs.description: Shelters, distribution, church hubs, relief containers, individual assistance registration and payments.

arcs.name: Aid accounts hijacked
arcs.description: Applicants' deposit details changed; account takeovers; protections; restitution; link to diverted funds.

arcs.name: Emergency contracts
arcs.description: Sole-source debris and fuel contracts, overbilling records, fuel supplier suspension, warrants, offshore owner.

arcs.name: Who got help
arcs.description: Low-income surge-zone tracts wait longer for 911 and receive less aid; analysis and response.

arcs.name: Rumors and fact-checks
arcs.description: Viral false claims, coordinated accounts, a shared lure domain, fact-checks, a foreign state broadcaster's spin.

arcs.name: Crisis abroad
arcs.description: An unnamed foreign power's exercises and later operations abroad; the deployment's significance; attribution.

arcs.name: Rebuild and lessons
arcs.description: Hardening plans, advisories, after-action lessons, six-month look-back.

arcs.name: The utility intrusion
arcs.description: Coverage of the power and water utility's long restoration, the relay and control-system anomalies, the federal confirmation of unauthorized access, the isolation of its control network and the return to service.

arcs.name: Eyes from above
arcs.description: Coverage of the aerial damage assessment: reconnaissance flights, drone and thermal surveys, damage estimates and the imagery archive.

arcs.name: The longest shift
arcs.description: Coverage of the 911 center through the surge: record call volume, mutual aid, the false-call cluster near utility sites and the return to normal.

arcs.name: Two languages, one crisis
arcs.description: Coverage of delays in Spanish-language alerts and services, with KNCB Coastal Bend Radio as the main Spanish-language source.

arcs.name: The network behind the noise
arcs.description: Coverage of coordinated false public-safety posts during the storm and recovery, the referrals to law enforcement and the platform removals.

arcs.name: The hospitals hold the line
arcs.description: Coverage of the hospitals during the response: the trauma wave, generator power, capacity limits and the waterborne illness cluster.

arcs.name: Race against the tide
arcs.description: Coverage of search and rescue from the first helicopter launches to the certified final count.

arcs.name: Eyes in the dark
arcs.description: Coverage of unauthorized drone flights near utility and port sites before the storm, the federal confirmation and the counter-drone programme.

arcs.name: The alert system speaks
arcs.description: Coverage built on official emergency alerts and broadcasts: warnings, evacuation orders, shelter-in-place, boil-water notices and their lifting.

arcs.name: The claim that wasn't
arcs.description: Coverage of disaster fraud: contractor scams, inflated insurance claims, the state task force and the federal arrests.
